stories: tall-wardrobe: My clothes keep getting stretched.
unordered-parcel: Every night at midnight, someone knocks with a parcel.
lost-tuesday: My calendar skipped a day.
goodnight-text: Every night at three oh seven, someone texts me goodnight.
smart-speaker: I asked my laptop for the weather.
leftovers-cctv: Someone keeps eating my leftovers.
slow-reflection: My reflection has always been a little slow.
ghost-rent: My flat costs half price.
sleepover-count: Four of us went to sleep at my sleepover.
shadow-quits: This morning, my shadow didn't follow me.
lights-out: My sister dared me to play lights out.
tenth-floor: There's a face at my window every night.
midnight-tea: My kitchen light turns on by itself at midnight.
three-am-knock: Every night at three, something knocks on my front door.
attic-grandma: Grandma calls me every night at ten.
dad-snoring: Dad snores like a broken motorbike.
officer-tomorrow: A police officer knocked on my door at noon.
homework-doll: Every morning, my homework is already done.
mirror-advice: My reflection talks to me while I brush my teeth.
midnight-chef-neighbour: My neighbour texts me every night complaining about my kitchen light.
the-better-double: My mum texted thanking me for visiting, but I was still in bed.
ghost-laundry-standards: I live completely alone, but every morning my shirts are neatly ironed.
neighbour-lost-found: My friendly neighbour knocks at midnight to return things I haven't lost yet.
cursed-sleep-doll: My sister left an antique porcelain doll here that strictly enforces an eight-hour sleep schedule.
hallway-landlord: An unnaturally tall man in a black suit stands in my hallway every midnight.
midnight-pizza-delivery: Imagine every midnight, a steaming hot pizza box appears outside your locked front door.
midnight-pizza-delivery-part2: Last time, a creepy delivery man stepped straight out of your dark bedroom wardrobe.
dog-came-home-p1: Imagine your dog has been missing for two days.
dog-came-home-p2: Last time, your missing dog came home. And stood on two legs.
voice-note-tomorrow-p1: Imagine your best friend sends you a voice note at two a.m.
voice-note-tomorrow-p2: Last time, someone knocked with your best friend's voice. And the real one said he was under your bed.
lift-mirror: Imagine you get into the lift alone at midnight.
extra-chair: Imagine you set the table for dinner. Four plates. Four chairs.
wrong-number: Imagine your phone rings at 3 a.m. Unknown number.
wall-at-school: Imagine you lean against the wall in your school corridor.
mum-home-early: Imagine you're home alone after school.
end-of-the-bed: Imagine you wake up at 3 a.m. and you can't move.
second-knock: My grandma has one rule.
extra-face-call: Imagine a late-night video call with your best friends.
cassette-my-name: Imagine you're cleaning Grandma's old cupboard.
missing-you: Imagine you walk to school on a normal morning.
dog-came-home-p3: Since my dog came home wrong, I lock my bedroom door every night.
borrowed-shadow: In my town, you get your shadow on your thirteenth birthday.
babysitter-rules: Congratulations. You got the babysitting job at the Marlow house.
last-bus-seat: Imagine you catch the last bus home. It's empty.
hide-and-seek: Imagine you're babysitting your little cousin.
ice-cream-van-3am: Imagine you hear the ice cream van song. At three a.m.
red-balloons-window: Imagine a red balloon is tied to your window. The card says "Happy birthday."
crow-says-my-name: Imagine a crow sits on your fence every morning. You feed it toast.
hallway-light: My new house has one rule.
radio-tomorrow: Grandpa's old radio doesn't play today's news. It plays tomorrow's.
wendell-said-yes: On his fiftieth birthday, chemistry teacher Wendell Gray coughed so hard at the car wash, a customer tipped him out of pity.
